content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The electrical illustration and clear call button feel tailored to the trade, but the full-page view shows navigation covering hero content and several redundant contact blocks below.",
  "desktopNote": "The coherent electrical motif gives the page character, but oversized typography, repeated contact sections and navigation obscuring the hero undermine the finish.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Correct the sticky navigation positioning on both viewports so it never masks hero text or contact links.",
    "Consolidate the dark contact section and subsequent “Obiščite nas” block into one contact destination, leaving only legal information in the footer.",
    "Reduce the desktop headline, year and closing phone-number sizes, tighten the hero-to-credentials gap, and bring the service area into the hero so location is apparent before the call action."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone: navigation overlaps the hero’s supporting contact content in the full-page view.",
    "Desktop: navigation obscures the second line of the hero headline in the full-page view.",
    "Phone and desktop: the address and directions block is repeated immediately below the main contact section."
  ]
}
